questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Find central housing (a WG is probably nicest)
2. Be daring - Berlin offer many opportunities, try them all
3. Berlin is not all about clubbing. The scene can be draining, so make sure you find people who will also go with you to the amazing museums

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Decide what you want out from your stay and go for that

questions.answer: Learning to be alone sometimes

questions.question: Any other comments?
